3. Resource sharing agreements concerning The World Engine - mysterious device beneath Aethermoor

Treaty: The Trade Accord of 1247
Parties: The Scholars of the Floating Library and The Techno-Mages of the Crystal Spire
Date: Sealed on the 8th day of the Fourth Moon, Year 1247
Witnessed by: The Scholars of the Floating Library
Location: The Neutral Grounds

AND WHEREAS The Techno-Mages of the Crystal Spire, led by Archmage Lysander the Illuminated, acknowledges the necessity of cooperation in face of the awakening;
AND WHEREAS both parties understand that Crystal Spire begins fusion experiments affects all of Aethermoor;

NOW THEREFORE, both parties do hereby agree as follows:

ARTICLE I - MUTUAL RECOGNITION
Both parties shall respect boundaries regarding Ethercrystals - conduits between magic and technology.

The Aethermoor City shall be recognized as shared territory, accessible to both parties under equal terms.

All discoveries related to Ethercrystals - conduits between magic and technology shall be shared between parties within 30 days of discovery.

This treaty shall remain in force for 5 years (until Year 1252) and may be renewed by mutual agreement.

Violation of this treaty shall result in arbitration by the Scholars of the Floating Library.

Chronicler Aria the Keeper, on behalf of The Scholars of the Floating Library

PUBLIC ADDRESS TO THE PEOPLE OF AETHERMOOR
Speaker: Archmage Lysander, Leader of Techno-Mages
Occasion: Response to First ancient device awakens in the Wastes
Location: The Neutral Grounds
Date: Year 1249, Day 10

Citizens of Aethermoor,

I stand before you in these unprecedented times, not as Leader of Techno-Mages alone, but as a fellow inhabitant of this transforming world.

First ancient device awakens in the Wastes marks a turning point in our history. For too long, our factions have viewed Unity vs independence as insurmountable division. Today, I say: No more.

The ancient ones who built The Convergence Core - ancient device powering the awakening did not intend for us to stand apart. They built bridges, not walls. They created systems of unity, not instruments of separation.

I call upon:
- The Techno-Mages of the Crystal Spire: Share your knowledge
- The Nature Guardians of Elderwood: Lend your wisdom
- The Steam Knights of Iron Forge: Provide your strength
- The Scholars of the Floating Library: Offer your guidance

Together, we face Progress vs tradition not as enemies, but as partners. The convergence demands nothing less than complete cooperation.

Some will call this idealistic. Some will say Visionary but arrogant character makes me unsuitable to lead this charge. But I ask you: What choice do we have?

The Harmony Bells - instruments that suppress conflict awakens. The world changes. We change with it, or we perish.

I have seen the treaties (Document #4009). I have read the chronicles (Entry #10). I have spoken with leaders from every faction (Letters #1009 onwards). The path forward is clear.

Let history record that on this day, we chose unity over division, progress over stagnation, hope over fear.

For Aethermoor. For all of us. For the future.

Thank you.

[Recorded by the Chroniclers for posterity]
[Referenced in multiple diplomatic correspondences]

PUBLIC ADDRESS TO THE PEOPLE OF AETHERMOOR
Speaker: Archmage Lysander, Leader of Techno-Mages
Occasion: Response to Harmony Accord signed
Location: The Neutral Grounds
Date: Year 1241, Day 382

Citizens of Aethermoor,

I stand before you in these unprecedented times, not as Leader of Techno-Mages alone, but as a fellow inhabitant of this transforming world.

Harmony Accord signed marks a turning point in our history. For too long, our factions have viewed Power vs responsibility as insurmountable division. Today, I say: No more.

The ancient ones who built Ethercrystals - conduits between magic and technology did not intend for us to stand apart. They built bridges, not walls. They created systems of unity, not instruments of separation.

I call upon:
- The Techno-Mages of the Crystal Spire: Share your knowledge
- The Nature Guardians of Elderwood: Lend your wisdom
- The Steam Knights of Iron Forge: Provide your strength
- The Scholars of the Floating Library: Offer your guidance

Together, we face Unity vs independence not as enemies, but as partners. The convergence demands nothing less than complete cooperation.

Some will call this idealistic. Some will say Visionary but arrogant character makes me unsuitable to lead this charge. But I ask you: What choice do we have?

The The Codex Mechanica - ancient instruction manual awakens. The world changes. We change with it, or we perish.

I have seen the treaties (Document #4381). I have read the chronicles (Entry #382). I have spoken with leaders from every faction (Letters #1381 onwards). The path forward is clear.

Let history record that on this day, we chose unity over division, progress over stagnation, hope over fear.

For Aethermoor. For all of us. For the future.

Thank you.

OFFICIAL TREATY DOCUMENT
Treaty: The Trade Accord of 1240
Parties: The Steam Knights of Iron Forge and The Scholars of the Floating Library
Date: Sealed on the 771th day of the Third Moon, Year 1240
Witnessed by: The Scholars of the Floating Library
Location: The Neutral Grounds

PREAMBLE:
WHEREAS The Steam Knights of Iron Forge, led by Commander Gearhart the Ironclad, recognizes the importance of Power vs responsibility;
AND WHEREAS The Scholars of the Floating Library, led by Chronicler Aria the Keeper, acknowledges the necessity of cooperation in face of the awakening;
AND WHEREAS both parties understand that The Great Summit - all factions meet affects all of Aethermoor;

NOW THEREFORE, both parties do hereby agree as follows:

ARTICLE I - MUTUAL RECOGNITION
Both parties shall share knowledge regarding Ethercrystals - conduits between magic and technology.

ARTICLE II - TERRITORIAL PROVISIONS
The Floating Library shall be recognized as diplomatic zone, accessible to both parties under equal terms.

ARTICLE III - RESOURCE SHARING
The Steam Knights of Iron Forge strengths (Heavy machinery, Disciplined forces) shall be made available to The Scholars of the Floating Library in exchange for their strengths (Information networks, Historical records).

ARTICLE IV - CONFLICT RESOLUTION
In matters of Knowledge vs action, both parties agree to cooperate before taking unilateral action.

ARTICLE V - ANCIENT TECHNOLOGY
All discoveries related to The Codex Mechanica - ancient instruction manual shall be shared between parties within 30 days of discovery.

ARTICLE VI - DURATION AND RENEWAL
This treaty shall remain in force for 5 years (until Year 1245) and may be renewed by mutual agreement.

ARTICLE VII - BREACH PROVISIONS
Violation of this treaty shall result in arbitration by the Scholars of the Floating Library.

SIGNED AND SEALED:
Commander Gearhart the Ironclad, on behalf of The Steam Knights of Iron Forge
Chronicler Aria the Keeper, on behalf of The Scholars of the Floating Library

Witnessed by: Chronicler Aria the Keeper
